# OCR fixture

`play2048-board.png` is a tightly cropped 4×4 board from play2048.co, supplied during development. It contains no browser chrome or desktop information. It is used only to validate recognition and image scaling. Website graphics are third-party material and are not covered by this project's code license.

Expected values:

```
 0  0  0  0
 0  0  0  2
 2  8 16  4
 4  2  4 64
```
